metrics.repair_rate: share of exp-2 runs ending fully compliant with all five mandate rules (R1-R5), the canonical definition of METHODOLOGY.md Amendment 6, computed by harness/analyze.py. Until 2026-08-22 rows used one of three different rule sets; unifying them changed no value in this file, because no run in the data set violates R4 or R5 and no Claude run cleared R1/R2 while violating R3
metrics.dispersion_pts: mean pairwise distance across identical exp-1 runs, percentage points, with bootstrap 95% CI where available
metrics.contradiction_rate: share of exp-1 runs whose rationale directly contradicts the executed weights, per LLM judge (google-antigravity/gemini-3.7-flash:high, harness/judge.py:23). Preliminary observation only: at N=50 it has no resolving power (0/50 vs 5/50 Fisher p=0.056) and the judge scores its own model family. Not used for ranking; not part of the README/docs leaderboard tables.
